header.title: Open Pointcloud Studio
header.heroAlt: Open Pointcloud Studio with a point cloud of a house and garden, the project browser with scans, classes and views on the left and the properties on the right
header.label: Point clouds
header.tagline: From laser scan to measurement, drawing and mesh, in one free app
header.desc: Open a scan of millions of points and look around in it straight away. Measure what you need, cut a plan or section from the cloud and take it to your CAD program as DXF or DWG, or turn it into a mesh or the faces of a room.

meta.description: Free, open-source desktop app for laser scans and point clouds (LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY): view, measure and clean up, plans and sections in DXF or DWG, meshes and detected faces, also to IFC. For Windows, macOS and Linux.
meta.title: Open Pointcloud Studio — OpenAEC Foundation

view.alt: Point cloud of a house coloured by elevation, with the Display panel open beneath the view cube
view.title: Even a scan of a hundred million points stays smooth
view.desc: The app builds an index on disk and loads the detail where you look, up to ten million points in view at once. Colour the points by RGB, elevation, intensity or class, and switch classes such as vegetation or ground off one by one.

measure.alt: Measured height of 5.600 m along the facade of a house, with the selection in orange on the roof and the measured values in the properties
measure.title: Measure in the scan instead of on site
measure.desc: Click two points and read the length, the horizontal distance and the height difference. Areas are measured in their own plane, so a wall or a sloped roof is right too. Select, delete or thin points; your source file is never touched.

box.alt: Section box with six draggable faces around a house in the point cloud
box.title: Cut out exactly the part you need
box.desc: A box with six draggable faces limits what you see, measure, export and draw. If a building stands at an angle in the scan, Align to walls turns the box along its walls.

drawing.alt: Section A of a house as a 2D drawing in its own tab, with the drawing layers and the Export DXF/DWG button on the right
drawing.title: From scan to plan and section in DWG
drawing.desc: Make a plan, elevation or section at 1:1, with filled walls and floors and straight, editable CAD lines on a layer of their own. Save it as DXF or DWG, or place it on a sheet from A4 to A0 and export to PDF.

mesh.alt: The Mesh Pointcloud window with its four methods: closed mesh, terrain mesh, 3D surface and flat faces
mesh.title: A closed mesh or the faces of a room
mesh.desc: Choose from four methods: a closed mesh of a room with its measured deviation, a terrain mesh, a quick 3D surface, or the floors, walls and columns as separate faces with their areas. Export to OBJ, PLY, STL, DXF, DWG or IFC4.

photos.alt: Panorama photo of a scan station in its own tab, with a slider for the photo and the Compare with 3D button
photos.title: Stand where the scanner stood
photos.desc: Click a scan station and look around in its panorama photo, which lies over the points so you can measure there too. Put the photo beside the 3D model, side by side or stacked, or give a scan without colours the colours of its photos.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything for your laser scans, in one app
features.sub: Start with the highlights, or pick a topic.

formats.title: All common scan formats
formats.desc: LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, PCD, PTX, PTS and text files, plus meshes in OBJ, PLY, OFF and STL. Just drag them onto the window.

project.title: A whole scan project at once
project.desc: Open a folder of scans or a scan project file (.rcp): all scans open together, each as a layer you show or hide.

large.title: Large scans without waiting
large.desc: You see the points while the file is still being read. The index on disk is reused, so a scan opens in a blink the next time.

colour.title: Four colour modes and classes
colour.desc: RGB, elevation, intensity or class, with eye-dome lighting and an adjustable point size. Switch each class on or off on its own.

stations.title: Stations, photos and walking
stations.desc: Scan stations from E57, PCD and PTX are shown. Stand in a panorama, step through the photos and walk through the scan with W, A, S and D.

tabs.title: Everything in tabs
tabs.desc: The 3D model, views, plans, sections, sheets and photos sit side by side as tabs and come back at the next start.

measuretool.title: Distance and area
measuretool.desc: Length, horizontal length and height difference; area in its own plane and seen from above, with the perimeter. Points come from the whole scan, not only from what is on screen.

select.title: Select and clean up
select.desc: Select with a rectangle, delete with undo, thin to an exact percentage, or move and scale a cloud. An export writes the result.

views.title: Views, notes and BCF
views.desc: Save the camera, section box and colour as a view, add notes and arrows, and send it all as BCF 2.1 to your BIM program.

rotatebox.title: Rotatable section box
rotatebox.desc: Type the limits as coordinates, fit the box to a selection or let it align to the walls. Where it cuts a mesh, the cut looks solid.

section.title: Plan, elevation and section
section.desc: A 2D drawing at 1:1 as DXF or DWG (R2004 to R2018), with a filled cut, open door and window openings and straight CAD lines.

drawview.title: View the drawing right away
drawview.desc: Every drawing opens in the app itself, with layers, scale bar and coordinates. Open CAD Studio comes with it to view DXF and DWG.

sheets.title: Sheets from A4 to A0
sheets.desc: Place views and drawings to scale on a sheet with a title block, add dimensions, text and leaders, and export to PDF.

closedmesh.title: Closed mesh of a room
closedmesh.desc: A surface without overlaps, with door and window openings left open. You see the mean, the 95% and the largest distance between points and mesh.

terrain.title: Terrain mesh and 3D surface
terrain.desc: A ground surface from the lowest points, or a quick impression of a whole scan with walls and overhangs.

faces.title: Detect faces and columns
faces.desc: Floors, ceilings, walls and sloped faces with their outlines and openings, and round columns and pipes, each with its area and residual.

texture.title: Mesh with colour and texture
texture.desc: Write a coloured mesh as OBJ with a PNG texture. Colours from E57 photos are carried into new meshes.

cadbim.title: To CAD and BIM
cadbim.desc: Meshes and detected faces as OBJ, PLY, STL, as 3D geometry in DXF or DWG, or as IFC4 elements with their measured values.

export.title: Export and merge
export.desc: The whole cloud, the selection, the section box or every Nth point as LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, XYZ, PTS or CSV, with every point of the source. Merge LAS and LAZ scans.

bag.title: 3D BAG buildings
bag.desc: Fetch building models of the Netherlands from the 3D BAG for an area up to 2 by 2 km and show them with your scan.

mcp.title: MCP server and command API
mcp.desc: An AI assistant or your own script opens scans, measures, draws sections, makes meshes and asks for a picture of the 3D view.

cli.title: Command line without a window
cli.desc: Convert, crop, merge, index, draw sections, mesh and detect faces in your own scripts.

sdk.title: C library and cloud API
sdk.desc: The point-cloud core as a C library for your own software, and as a service over HTTP and MCP in a container.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.desc: Add tasks of your own with a script in any language, such as Python or PowerShell, that drives the window through the command API.

themes.title: Dutch and English, five themes
themes.desc: The interface follows the language of your system. Light, Forge, OpenAEC, Blueprint and high contrast, in the style of all OpenAEC apps.

download.title: Download v2026.44.1
download.lead: Free, no account needed. For Windows, macOS and Linux.
download.label: Download
download.mobileNote: Open Pointcloud Studio is a desktop app. Download it on your computer.

style.title: The style of all OpenAEC apps
style.desc: Title strip, ribbon, tabs, panels, the File menu and the settings share their look with the other OpenAEC desktop apps, with one bar at the top.

lines.title: Straight CAD lines
lines.desc: Plans and sections get closed, editable polylines along the cut, also in a turned section box, on a layer of their own.

compare.title: Photo beside the 3D model
compare.desc: An E57 photo opens in a tab of its own and sits beside or above a 3D pane with its own camera and a draggable divider.

texture.title: Mesh with texture
texture.desc: Texture surface writes a coloured mesh as OBJ with UV coordinates and a PNG texture, with progress and cancel.

signed.title: Signed installers
signed.desc: The Windows installer and app carry a valid signature, and the macOS app is notarized by Apple and simply opens.

api.title: Cloud API and C library
api.desc: The core now also comes as a service over HTTP and MCP in a container, and as a C library for Windows, macOS and Linux.

whatsnew.label: New in v2026.44
whatsnew.title: New look, straight CAD lines
whatsnew.desc: Version 2026.44 gives the window the style of all OpenAEC apps, draws straight lines in your sections and puts a photo beside the 3D model. The installers are signed, and versions now follow the year and week.

files.a: Point clouds in LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, PCD, PTX, PTS and text (XYZ, ASC, TXT, CSV): the open formats that laser scanners and scan software export. Also meshes in OBJ, PLY, OFF and STL, points and faces from an ASCII DXF, and the scan list of a scan project file (.rcp). It does not open the closed scan copies (.rcs) or DWG files.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: Yes, it is a desktop app; there is no web version. The Windows installer works without administrator rights, and the Linux AppImage starts without installing. Open CAD Studio, to view drawings, is already included.

price.q: What does Open Pointcloud Studio cost?
price.a: Nothing. The app is free and open source under the GPL-3.0 and the point-cloud core under the LGPL-3.0, with no account or subscription.

save.q: In which format is my work saved?
save.a: In open formats, and your scan itself never changes. You export what you make as LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, XYZ, PTS or CSV, drawings as DXF, DWG or PDF, meshes and faces as OBJ, PLY, STL, JSON or IFC4, and views as BCF. The app keeps views and notes per scan; there is no project file of its own.

systems.q: Which systems does it run on?
systems.a: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), macOS 11 and later (Apple and Intel) and Linux x86-64 (.deb and AppImage), with a Vulkan driver or OpenGL ES 3. The release page also has a zip without an installer and experimental packages for Linux on 64-bit ARM.

practice.a: Yes. Drawings go to your CAD program as DXF or DWG, faces and meshes to BIM as IFC4, and remarks as BCF 2.1. Buildings from the 3D BAG are fetched in Dutch RD coordinates. Measurements are in metres; the coordinates of a scan are not converted.

ai.q: What can an AI assistant do with it?
ai.a: open-pointcloud-studio --mcp starts an MCP server (Model Context Protocol). With it, an assistant such as Claude can open scans, set the camera and the section box, measure, export, draw sections, make meshes and detect faces, and get a picture of the 3D view back. Every window also has a local command API for your own scripts.

size.q: How large can a scan be?
size.a: Large. A 3.2 GiB PLY with 114 million points opens with its index in a fraction of a second, and selecting in a box of 100 by 100 by 100 m takes about half a second. An index can take several gigabytes on disk for a large survey.

accuracy.q: How reliable are the filled cut, the closed mesh and the faces?
accuracy.a: They are derived from the points and so far measured on generated rooms, not yet on a scan of a real building. A wall scanned from one side becomes a thin strip, and narrow strips such as door reveals do not become a face. That is why the app shows the measured deviation with every mesh; check the result before you use it.

bim.q: Does it make a complete floor plan or a BIM model automatically?
bim.a: Not yet. You make plans and sections yourself with the section box, and detected faces go along as separate IFC4 elements. The Pointcloud to Drawing wizard now finds the levels of a building; the steps for walls, openings and the IFC model are still being built.

rust.title: Rust
rust.desc: One native program without a browser or web view, for Windows, macOS and Linux, with small, signed packages.

ui.title: iced and openaec-ui
ui.desc: The interface in iced, with the shared Rust crate openaec-ui for the title strip, ribbon, tabs, panels and themes, as in the other OpenAEC desktop apps.

wgpu.title: wgpu
wgpu.desc: Draws millions of points and meshes on the graphics card through Vulkan, Metal, DirectX or OpenGL ES.

octree.title: Octree index on disk
octree.desc: Supplies the detail for the current viewpoint within a point budget and is kept for the next time.

cad.title: Open CAD Studio
cad.desc: The open-source CAD app by Hakan Seven and contributors comes in every package and shows exported DXF and DWG drawings.

api.title: MCP, API, CLI and C
api.desc: An MCP server, a local command API, a command line, a cloud API in a container and a C library (ABI 1.0) under the LGPL.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.
